answer.generated: Top-down approaches begin with system-level hazards and analyze potential failures progressively, whereas bottom-up approaches start with component-level faults and trace them up to system-level impacts. Thus, FMECA focuses on detailed failure modes, while STPA provides a holistic view by considering operational processes.
